mitigation_comparison.note: ThresholdOptimizer applies subgroup-specific thresholds to reduce equalized-odds gap. It is evaluated here for governance reporting only. Live scoring uses the single global calibrated threshold to avoid unvalidated differential treatment.
mitigation_comparison.mitigation_tradeoff: Equalizing TPR across subgroups typically reduces overall recall slightly while reducing disparity. The specific trade-off depends on the subgroup composition of the operational cohort.
